text.en: Six women set sail to go all the way around the globe.

The text reports the Indian Navy's all-women crew, skippered by Lt. Cdr. Vartika Joshi, which broke many stereotypes by sailing around the world. The other crew members named are Lt. Cdr. Pratibha Jamwal, Lt. Cdr. Swathi Patarapalli, Lt. Aishwarya Boddapati, Lt. Vijaya Devi and Lt. Payal Gupta.
The lesson compares this feat with earlier Indian circumnavigations, such as Capt. Dilip Donde's solo voyage in 2009-10 aboard INSV Mhadei. It shows that women are equal to men in courage and skill.
Learn the words circumnavigate, skipper, crew, stereotype and navigate. This is a news-style report, so find the who, what, when and where.
